newsitem.title: USA: BRUSH WELLMAN FORMS SINGAPORE JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: BRUSH WELLMAN FORMS SINGAPORE JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Brush Wellman Inc said Monday it had formed a joint venture with Semitron Materials in Singapore to better serve customers in Singapore and Malaysia.
Brush said the venture is known as Brush Semitron Service Center Pte Ltd. Semitron Materials will manage the venture, which processes beryllium copper strip products.
Brush said Brush Semitron Service Center will eventually supply beryllium copper strip products to customers in China, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines and Brunei.
